name: Allsorts
description: Licorice allsorts in a loose heap of rows: striped sandwiches of fondant and licorice, coconut wheels round a black core and fondant squares round a licorice one.

code.style: --rule: ( --z0: @r(1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --k: @p(0, 1, 2); --mk: @match($(k) == 0, @var(--m0), $(k) == 1, @var(--m1), @var(--m2)); transform: translate(@r(-5%, 5%), @r(-5%, 5%)) rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg)) rotate(@r(-12deg, 12deg)) scale(.8); border-radius: @match($(k) == 1, 50%, 7%); background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); opacity: @match($(k) == 0, 1, 0%); -webkit-mask: @var(--mid); mask: @var(--mid); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: @var(--mk); mask: @var(--mk); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --m0: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 27%, #000 27% 38%, transparent 38% 62%, #000 62% 73%, transparent 73%); --m1: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 40%, transparent 40%); --m2: linear-gradient(#000, #000) center / 46% 46% no-repeat; --mid: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 38%, #000 38% 62%, transparent 62%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
